description: Polls a Slack channel for chat-requested job/asset runs and launches them -- but only for a requester already listed as an owner of the target.

slack_channel_id.label: Slack Channel Id
slack_channel_id.description: Channel ID to poll (e.g. 'C0123ABCDEF') -- NOT a '#channel-name'; conversations.history requires the real id. Find it via the channel's 'View channel details' panel in Slack.

triggers.label: Triggers
triggers.description: Phrase-to-target mappings this sensor recognizes. At least one required.

phrases.description: Case-insensitive substrings (unless case_sensitive_phrases=true) that identify this trigger in a message's text, e.g. ['run the nightly etl', 'kick off nightly']. The first trigger (in list order) with a phrase appearing anywhere in the message wins -- list more specific triggers first if phrases could overlap.

asset_selection.description: Materialize this asset selection when matched: explicit key list, the Dagster selection DSL (tag:/group:/kind:/boolean composition), '*', or a bare fnmatch glob -- resolved against sibling assets in the same defs folder. Owners are read LIVE from the matched assets' own `owners` catalog metadata; do not also set `owners` on this trigger.

job_name.description: Run this named job when matched, instead of an asset_selection -- for job-shaped targets with no asset metadata of their own. Requires `owners` below: a bare job has no Dagster metadata to authorize against.

owners.description: Email addresses (or literal Slack user ids, e.g. 'U0123ABCD') allowed to trigger `job_name` from chat. Required when job_name is set -- there is no implicit default. Ignored for asset_selection triggers, whose owners come from the matched assets' own catalog metadata instead.

slack_bot_token_env_var.label: Slack Bot Token Env Var
slack_bot_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the bot's 'xoxb-...' token. Needs channels:history (or groups:history) + chat:write + users:read.email scopes -- see this file's module docstring, 'Auth'.

require_owner_authorization.label: Require Owner Authorization
require_owner_authorization.description: Require the message sender to be a listed owner of the matched target before launching it. THIS IS THE SAFETY CHECK THIS COMPONENT EXISTS TO ENFORCE -- setting it to false means ANY channel member can launch ANY configured trigger's target. Only disable it for a channel where every member is already trusted with every configured target.

resolve_requester_email.label: Resolve Requester Email
resolve_requester_email.description: Resolve the message sender's Slack user id to an email address via users.info (needs users:read.email) before checking owners -- most owners: lists use emails, not Slack user ids. When false, only a literal Slack user id in an owners list can ever match.

require_all_owners.label: Require All Owners
require_all_owners.description: For an asset_selection trigger matching MULTIPLE assets with different owners: false (default) authorizes the requester if they own ANY matched asset; true requires them to own EVERY matched asset. Ignored for job_name triggers.

case_sensitive_phrases.label: Case Sensitive Phrases
case_sensitive_phrases.description: Match trigger phrases case-sensitively. Default: case-insensitive.

messages_per_poll.label: Messages Per Poll
messages_per_poll.description: Messages to request per Slack page (Slack's own recommended max is 200).

max_pages_per_poll.label: Max Pages Per Poll
max_pages_per_poll.description: Follow at most this many pagination cursors per poll -- bounds how far back a single tick can catch up after an outage.

process_backlog_on_first_run.label: Process Backlog On First Run
process_backlog_on_first_run.description: If false (default), the first-ever tick seeds the cursor to 'now' and processes nothing -- activating this sensor never replays a channel's past run requests. Set true only if that replay is actually wanted.

post_acknowledgement.label: Post Acknowledgement
post_acknowledgement.description: Reply in-thread when a match is authorized and launched, and (per on_unauthorized) when it's rejected. Needs chat:write.

on_unauthorized.label: On Unauthorized
on_unauthorized.description: 'reply' (default) posts unauthorized_message_template as a threaded reply; 'skip' just logs it. Ignored when post_acknowledgement is false.

ack_message_template.label: Ack Message Template
ack_message_template.description: Threaded reply posted on an authorized match. Placeholders: {target}, {requester}, {phrase}.

unauthorized_message_template.label: Unauthorized Message Template
unauthorized_message_template.description: Threaded reply posted on an unauthorized match (on_unauthorized: reply). Placeholders: {target}, {requester}, {phrase}.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: 'RUNNING' or 'STOPPED' -- initial status of the sensor.
